mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum total of the thought pattern of the African people."
African traditional thought is the sum total of the thought pattern of the African people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a resentment of the slave against the master, and prevents outstanding men from growth."
The slave morality is a resentment of the slave against the master, and prevents outstanding men from growth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Supreme God in Yoruba religion, and it is Absoluteness."
Olodumare is the Supreme God in Yoruba religion, and it is Absoluteness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very aspect of the human existence and it helps man psychologically, spiritually, socially and economically."
Religion is a very aspect of the human existence and it helps man psychologically, spiritually, socially and economically.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the controversy surrounding it, to the extent that certain Eurocentric intellectuals question the authenticity of the discipline of African philosophy."
The debate on African philosophy is the controversy surrounding it, to the extent that certain Eurocentric intellectuals question the authenticity of the discipline of African philosophy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a hierarchical ordering of being and force (Agbo, 2018)."
The Africans' understanding of ontology is a hierarchical ordering of being and force (Agbo, 2018).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the results of the work done by the mediums."
Sacrifices are the results of the work done by the mediums.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relative thing and setting universal standards for anything is a mistaken idea."
Truth is a relative thing and setting universal standards for anything is a mistaken idea.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a wise individual who lives in a community."
A sage is a wise individual who lives in a community.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the living-dead who once co-existed with the rest of us, but later died a natural death at old age in order to keep watch over the community form the land of the living-dead."
The ancestors are the living-dead who once co-existed with the rest of us, but later died a natural death at old age in order to keep watch over the community form the land of the living-dead.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the aspect of learning which seeks to connect the ancient Egyptian civilization to world civilization."
Egyptology is the aspect of learning which seeks to connect the ancient Egyptian civilization to world civilization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to offer explanations for such occurrences."
Myths are used to offer explanations for such occurrences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a doctrine of social organizations, relations and networking; making it an offshoot of African humanism."
Communalism is a doctrine of social organizations, relations and networking; making it an offshoot of African humanism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the improvement of his condition and welfare."
The ultimate goal is the improvement of his condition and welfare.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cyclic return of a dead person through a new born child (Mbiti 1977)."
Reincarnation is a cyclic return of a dead person through a new born child (Mbiti 1977).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a patterned way of life shared by a particular group of people that claim a common origin or decent (Idang, 2015, p 98)."
Culture is a patterned way of life shared by a particular group of people that claim a common origin or decent (Idang, 2015, p 98).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for cultivating the whole person of the African (Mbiti 1977: 198)."
The traditional African religion is responsible for cultivating the whole person of the African (Mbiti 1977: 198).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as traditional philosophy, because thought gave rise to philosophy."
Traditional thought is the same as traditional philosophy, because thought gave rise to philosophy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a part and parcel of the African worldview."
The African traditional religion is a part and parcel of the African worldview.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the hallmark of the African universe because the world itself is created by a Being who is in charge of it by established laws and values."
Orderliness is the hallmark of the African universe because the world itself is created by a Being who is in charge of it by established laws and values.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reminder to our western counterparts that no culture is ironclad; every culture has something to benefit and gain from other surrounding cultures around."
Contemporary African thought is a reminder to our western counterparts that no culture is ironclad; every culture has something to benefit and gain from other surrounding cultures around.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with beliefs such as God, spirits, human life, magic, the hereafter, and so on."
African religion is concerned with beliefs such as God, spirits, human life, magic, the hereafter, and so on.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to appreciate and appease the gods and divinities in African tradition."
Rituals and sacrifices are used to appreciate and appease the gods and divinities in African tradition.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to act within the values and ethics of the community; values which are established for the sake of equity and fairness in the society."
Personhood is the ability to act within the values and ethics of the community; values which are established for the sake of equity and fairness in the society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the all-powerful and almighty creator of the universe, despite having other lesser god who are regarded as inferior mediators between the supreme and man."
The African believes that God is the all-powerful and almighty creator of the universe, despite having other lesser god who are regarded as inferior mediators between the supreme and man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the animating, sustaining, creative life- force of the universe."
Spirit is the animating, sustaining, creative life- force of the universe.
